title: Add CIDR overlap guard and peering safety checks for control plane provisioning
author: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: Private control plane peering and endpoint automation must fail-safe when customer VPCs have overlapping CIDRs or when peering would expose sensitive subnets. This PR introduces a plan-time and apply-time CIDR overlap detector and a configurable safety policy that prevents automatic peering attachments when a risky overlap is detected. The change adds: 1) a terraform pre-apply validation module that runs CIDR intersection checks and emits structured diagnostics; 2) installer controller logic to switch to a 'safe-attach' mode which will mark peering for manual review rather than auto-create attachments when the detector flags overlap; 3) a Helm flag enableCidrSafety=false/true to toggle strict enforcement for upgrades; 4) a dry-run output mode that surfaces the actionable diff (affected subnets, overlapping ranges, suggested prefix remaps) without making changes; 5) audit log entries and an explanatory message that surfaces in the console when a control plane rollouts fails due to safety checks. Migration notes: default behavior for existing installs is a non-blocking warning unless helm value enableCidrSafety is set to true in the chart override. For customers who want strict enforcement we document the downstream steps to reconcile overlaps (subnet renaming, prefixlist remapping, or transit gateway fallback). Implementation highlights: terraform/modules/vpc/overlap_check.tf implements the plan hook using a new null_resource local-exec step and returns structured output via tf output; installer/controllers/peering_controller.go now evaluates the detector outcome and atomically annotates controlplane objects with safety.status and safety.reason; helm/values/controlplane.yaml adds enableCidrSafety and dryRunSafetyMode flags; tests/integration/overlap_integration_test.go covers plan-time and controller rejection paths with mocked remote accounts; examples/upgrade-notes.md documents the step-by-step rollback if an upgrade flips enforcement on. Testing and rollout: ran tf validate and plan against three customer-like fixtures and a staging account, added unit coverage for the overlap algorithm including IPv4/IPv6 mixed ranges, added e2e smoke that verifies the annotated reason appears in the console. Rollout strategy: feature gate off by default; enable in a canary subset of internal customers for 2 weeks then flip for GA. Edge cases and fallbacks: when overlap is flagged and strict mode is on the controller will not create peering attachments, but will propose a fallback route via transit gateway or leave the existing peering intact and mark the new request for human review; the CLI offers --force-unsafe to bypass checks with an audited justification appended to the audit log. Security and compliance: Intersection checks reduce accidental exposure across customer boundaries and generate evidence for audits. Performance: plan-time check adds negligible overhead (ms-scale for typical VPC ranges). See linked Linear ENG-4231 for the design doc. Checklist: [x] design doc attached [x] tf module tests [x] controller unit tests [x] integration smoke tests [x] helm values and docs updated [x] security review requested. See release_notes for operator-facing details and migration guidance.
commit_summary: Initial overlap detector module and unit tests; add helm flags and dry-run plumbing; controller safety gating and annotation support; integration tests and example upgrade notes; fix lint issues and add e2e smoke
review_comments: Diego Chen: Please add a short-circuit for the common case where the peer VPC is explicitly whitelisted; otherwise we risk unnecessary manual reviews.
Ava Martinez (author): Added a whitelist override (helm value peerWhitelist) and documented auditing implications; updated tests to include whitelist path.
Priya Nair: Can we ensure the controller emits a single canonical reason string for alerts so SLO alerts can filter reliably?
Ava Martinez: Normalized reason codes to safety_reason_{OVERLAP|PRIVATE_RANGE|MIXED_IP_VERSION} and added unit tests asserting canonical reasons.
Samir Patel: Terraform plan-time check currently uses local-exec which won't run in remote plan contexts in some CI. Can we add a pure-Terraform validation path?
Ava Martinez: Added a fallback pure-Terraform math check using cidrhost/cidrsubnet where possible; retained local-exec for richer diagnostic output in local dev environments.
Hannah Li: Security review: request log redaction of account IDs in console messages. Also confirm no secrets are written to logs.
Ava Martinez: Redaction implemented; logs now use account masks and we explicitly avoid writing KMS or token material. Security review OKayed the change.
Priya Nair: Approved on behalf of infra team; please squash and merge once CI passes.
merge_outcome: squash and merge by Priya Nair
release_notes: Operator-facing: Add helm flag controlplane.enableCidrSafety (default: false). When enabled, control plane provisioning will block automatic peering attachments on detected CIDR overlaps and require manual review. Use examples/upgrade-notes.md to reconcile overlaps prior to enabling. CLI: new command 'redwoodctl controlplane plan-safety-check' produces a dry-run report. Backwards compatible when flag is unset.
related_issues: SUP-1123 customer ticket: customer reported accidental peering exposure
notes_for_release_engineers: During upgrade that flips enableCidrSafety from false to true, run redwoodctl controlplane plan-safety-check against each customer account to detect and remediate overlaps before enabling. If overlaps are found, follow docs/operator/migration-cidr-safety.md. The helm chart ships with a one-time postinstall hook that can run the check in dry-run mode; do not enable the hook in mass upgrades without a planned remediation window.
test_plan: Unit tests added for 4 overlap scenarios, integration test simulates cross-account peering with overlap and verifies controller annotates and does not create attachments, e2e smoke ensures audit logs are emitted with redacted account IDs. Manual verification: run terraform apply with TF_VAR_dry_run=true and confirm diagnostics file is produced.
changelog_entry: Added controlplane CIDR overlap detection and safety gating to private-installer (optional helm flag).
authors_notes: Follow-up PR planned to add automated prefixlist suggestions and a UI surface in the console for reviewers to approve blocked peering requests.
